title: (2025 AUG) Cumulative Updates for Business Central
summary: This post lists cumulative updates for Business Central versions 26, 25, and 24, explaining that the latest updates should always be installed as some fix security vulnerabilities. It provides links to update pages for on-premises versions and notes which older versions are no longer updated.
key_points: Three actively maintained versions have cumulative updates: v26 (2025 Wave 1), v25 (2024 Wave 2), and v24 (2024 Wave 1)
Latest updates should always be installed due to security vulnerability fixes
Updates include both global hotfixes and localization-specific hotfixes
Versions v23 and earlier are no longer receiving updates

quotes.text: Some updates additionally fix vulnerabilities, so the latest update should always be installed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that installing the latest cumulative update is a security imperative, not just a feature update

quotes.text: Updates include hotfixes that apply to all countries and hotfixes that apply to specific local versions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that updates address both global issues and localization-specific concerns
